messages.content: 約翰決定投資於兩個不同的基金。他在基金A投資了5000美元，該基金的年回報率為7％，他計劃將資金放在那裡5年。另一方面，他在基金B投資了8000美元，該基金的年回報率為5％，投資期為7年。你能預測約翰從基金A和基金B中獲得的利潤嗎？

function.name: investment_predictProfit
function.description: Predict the profit for given investment after specified number of years. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

annual_return.description: The annual return rate of the investment. This is a float type value.

years.description: The time period in years for which the investment is made.

message.reasoning:
The user wants predictions of profits from two investments. We have a tool "investment_predictProfit" that can predict profit for given investment after specified number of years. We need to call this tool twice: once for Fund A and once for Fund B.

We should use the tool with arguments:

For Fund A:
investment_amount: 5000
annual_return: 7
years: 5

For Fund B:
investment_amount: 8000
annual_return: 5
years: 7

We need to call the tool twice. According to guidelines, we should call the tool and then respond with the results. So we will first call the tool for Fund A. Then we will call the tool for Fund B. Then we will produce a response summarizing the predicted profits.

We should not provide any additional text before calling the tool. So we will do:

{
  "name": "investment_predictProfit",
  "arguments": {
    "investment_amount": 5000,
    "annual_return": 7,
    "years": 5
  }
}

Then after receiving the result, we call again for Fund B.

We need to handle the tool calls sequentially. The system will respond with the tool output. Then we call again. Then we produce final answer.

Thus we will do two tool calls.
